title: Vendor-namespaced control operations reuse shared control files without a sequencer surface

installed_sdk.rationale: The vendor operation headers are inspect control headers, not sequencer SDK surface. No sequencer header, target, or symbol changes.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: The CLI change lets the generic live-control verb call a vendor id the exact instance declares. pulp seq and the timeline document path are unchanged.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No timeline MCP tool, schema, or handler changes. The new MCP tool is a live-control vendor call.

live_product_control.rationale: Vendor operations are product-declared operations, not sequencer operations. The Standalone host keeps its sequencer state and transport executors as they were and only adds a vendor dispatch branch.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time agent capability is added or changed.
